doc.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Joining Lionel Hampton through Wallace Davenport
summary: After a night at the 1979 Jazz Festival with Hampton, Wallace Davenport urges him to take the job and he spends months in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: called Wallace and said, “Hey, who’s that boy that you had down there?” So Bill Titone called me and Wallace says, “Look, whatever kind of money they offer you, take it. That’s an experience that you can’t buy. Just take the job man.” He says, “Just take the job. In the future you’re not even going to think about it but it will help you so much.” So I did about five months of staying in the YMCA in New York.
